title: How blockchain is quietly revolutionizing supply chains

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Blockchain isn't just a buzzword—it's transforming supply chains through transparency, traceability, and real-time data sharing. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You’re ignoring the limitations—blockchain’s energy use and slow transaction speeds make it impractical for high-volume supply chains. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Smart contracts on Ethereum automate payments and compliance, cutting delays and fraud by up to 40% in pilot programs. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with layer-2 solutions, blockchain’s immutability can lock in errors—unlike traditional systems that allow for quick corrections. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Blockchain’s promise outpaces its performance—real change needs more than just a ledger. (4 sec)
